Van der Stap was arrested again in mid-September 2026 by the Dienst Speciale Interventies (DSI), the elite tactical unit of the Dutch National Police. Police are investigating van der Stap over suspected involvement with the hackers collective ShinyHunters. On 29 September 2026, Dutch authorities announced that van der Stap was additionally suspected of attempting to solicit two contract killings abroad. ... Pepijn van der Stap (born 2002) is a Dutch cybersecurity specialist and convicted criminal. While employed as a software engineer at the Amsterdam cybersecurity firm Hadrian and volunteering as a researcher for the Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD), he simultaneously orchestrated a criminal scheme involving the theft of data from millions of individuals and the extortion of companies for millions of euros.
